title: Trump lifts limits on Anthropic's Fable and Mythos models (Politico)
summary: Politico: Trump lifts limits on Anthropic's Fable and Mythos models … Anthropic, in a statement after the export controls were lifted, said it would restore access to customers beginning Wednesday. — “We're grateful to our users for their patience, and to everyone who worked with us on redeploying the models,” the company said.
